title: What Happens If You Coast in Neutral
hook: Stop coasting in neutral right now.

script.narration: Stop coasting in neutral right now.

Many drivers shift to neutral down hills to save fuel. But modern cars actually use zero fuel when your foot is off the gas in gear. Coasting cuts off vital automatic transmission fluid flow, causing serious damage over time.
Like if this helped, follow for daily driving tips. Did you know this? Comment yes or no, because you need to stop coasting in neutral right now.

description:
Learn what actually happens to your car transmission when you coast in neutral down a hill. This quick tip explains modern fuel injection and how to protect your car from costly gearbox repairs.

Subscribe for daily 60-second driving tips.
why_it_will_work: Leverages the proven high-performing 'What Happens If' style with a common driving myth, answering user searches for driving tips and tricks.
quality_problems: fact-check: The claim that coasting in neutral cuts off vital automatic transmission fluid flow and causes serious damage is factually incorrect for modern standard automatic transmissions, as the transmission pump is driven by the input side connected to the engine, which remains running.
